how_to_load.public_directory: world-cup-2026/teams.json + team_locations.json are already in the importer's shape. In the Gridlock repo: node scripts/import-world-cup.js world-cup-2026
how_to_load.event_data: On a phone: More › Account & backups › Event data, choose export/gridlock/event-data.json. Do not commit that file to the app repo.
how_to_load.games: Import export/gridlock/season-copy-games.json as a Gridlock season copy (data.games only, rows that are not already in the app's 78-row Pro seed). Or paste from export/gridlock-csv/games-not-in-app-seed.csv. Replacing SCHEDULE.games in the app source is a separate change and was not done.
how_to_load.scout_tally: Live Scout and Tally rows are logged in the app; this pack does not mint them. LSO tendencies are suggested scout.player patches only (see lso_scout_suggested).
